messages:
Evan: Quick heads-up — requesting a lightweight smoke + bench for Orbiter-8B on canary nodes. Need P50/P95/P99, tokens/sec, and a brief tail-latency profile. Please run standard smoke prompt set (3x seeds) and post artifacts.

Priya: On it. Can confirm canary cluster id is canary-eu-2. Which model ref did you push?

Evan: Model ref is orbiter-8b:v2026-03-15. No custom weights, default quant config. Focus on seq lens 128/512/1024. Keep batch sizes {1,4,8}.

Priya: Running now, will push logs + perf summary here when done. ETA ~25m.

perf-bot: Job queued: bench/orbiter-8b/v2026-03-15 on canary-eu-2 -> run id bench-2498765432-1. Artifacts will appear under /artifacts/bench-2498765432-1.

Marta: Quick note — aware of earlier regression on similar model where P99 spiked with seq=1024 due to KV cache mempressure. Will watch GPU utilization and swap events.

Priya: First pass results uploaded: /artifacts/bench-2498765432-1/summary.json (link). TL;DR: P50/P95 stable, P99 shows 18-22% increase for seq=1024 vs baseline. Tokens/sec roughly -8% at batch=8.

Marta: Pasting the short perf excerpt:

```
seq=1024 batch=8 | p50=45ms p95=110ms p99=310ms | tps=420
seq=512  batch=8 | p50=28ms p95=78ms  p99=120ms | tps=720
GPU util spike observed at tail: nvprof kernel fallback events: 3
Memory high-water mark: 11.6GB on 16GB card
```

Liam: Hmm the nvprof kernel fallback is worrying. Did the run use the fallback-friendly kernel set or the fast path?

Priya: Default runtime flags: `--kernels=auto --kv-cache=on --quant=4bit`. I didn't force any fallback flags.

Marta: My hypothesis: at seq=1024 with batch=8 we cross a workspace threshold and runtime selects an alternate kernel with higher latency. Two quick repros: reduce batch to 4, or toggle `--kernels=preferred`. Can someone rerun batch=4 for seq=1024?

Priya: Re-ran batch=4, attached new summary: P99 dropped to ~180ms, tps ~540. Artifacts /artifacts/bench-2498765432-1/retest-b4.json

Evan: Good repro. Action items: 1) create perf ticket with artifacts and baseline comparison, 2) assign to Marta for kernel triage, 3) plan a targeted canary run for `--kernels=preferred` and quant variations. Can someone open the ticket?

Liam: I'll open PERF-7863 and add the artifacts link + brief reproduction steps. Assigning to Marta.

perf-bot: Ticket created: PERF-7863 — "Orbiter-8B: P99 tail spike at seq=1024 on canary". Link: https://redwood.internal/perf/7863

Marta: Assigned and acknowledged. I'll start with kernel selection trace and compare the kernel launch logs. If it's a workspace threshold problem we can either tune workspace limits or add a config-based kernel pin for canary.

Evan: Prioritize root cause + mitigation that doesn't require model re-quant. If it's a runtime kernel choice, a config toggle for canary should be fine — we can roll out to Dedicated after validation.

Priya: FYI I also captured the runtime trace snippet (reduced):

```
[2026-03-15 16:12:03] kernel_launch: gemm_v2_fast fallback=false time=1.8ms
[2026-03-15 16:12:13] kernel_launch: attn_opt_v3 fallback=true  time=95.2ms
[2026-03-15 16:12:13] kv_cache_flush: triggered by mem_delta=1.2GiB
```

Marta: That matches. Attn kernel falling back — likely due to scratch workspace allocation for attn_opt_v3. I'll run local kernel-scheduler sim and report.

Liam: Suggest we also add a short canary job with `--batch-depad` and `--kernels=preferred` to measure overhead of forcing the fast path. I'll spin that up after Marta's sim.

Evan: Sounds good. Also please add a small note in the release checklist — if PERF-7863 isn't resolved we should gate any wide rollout of this model variant.

Priya: Noted. I'll pin the canary to green only after the retest with preferred kernels. :eyes:

Marta: I'll post kernel-sim results by EOD and a proposed fix (config toggle + rollout steps). Expect smaller PR to runtime for canary knob.

Liam: Thanks team — ping me if you need extra GPUs for isolating runs. :thumbsup:

Evan: Thanks. Closing this thread for now — we'll track in PERF-7863. :shipit:
